## Checks passed / failed / not tested
For receiving issues, distinguish modem registration, application receipt, push service response and actual client display.

Do not attach a database, backup, raw production logs, screenshots of real SMS, tokens, cookies or passwords. Security vulnerabilities should use private reporting instead of a public issue.
